brief:
Should I hire a marketing manager, or use an AI tool to plan the campaign for the next product feature launch, and use the money I'd save to spend more on advertising? Our budget for the year is £100,000. I can't spend more than 25% of my time on this, and I'm not that experienced with marketing.

I have two goals: For our new feature launch to be successful, we need to have a conversion rate of over 15% and secure 20 new customers within the first 3 months.
